info.desc: GUTS is the second studio album by American singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo. It was released on September 8, 2023, Via Geffen Records/Interscope Records. It was preceded by its lead single "Vampire", released on June 30, 2023. It debuted atop the Billboard Hot 100, scoring Rodrigo her third number-one single in the United States. The second single, "bad idea right?", was released on August 11, 2023. GUTS was released on September 8, 2023, via CD, cassette, streaming platforms, and three box set editions. Preorders for the album began on June 26, 2023. Vinyl LPs, in various colored variants, were also released, each .

podcast.body: This "superb second LP" debuted at number 1 and remained in the top 10 on the charts. It generated a number 1 Hot 100 smash with the song "Vampire." Olivia Rodrigo was seen as a strong contender for Album of the Year at the 2024 Grammys, fulfilling cultural impact and youth guidelines. "Her superb second LP Guts debuted at number 1 and is still lodged in the top 10."
